name: careyu-quotation
description: CARE YU quotation system — React frontend and Express API on one Cloudflare Worker

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.build: node scripts/embed-pdf-assets.js && node scripts/patch-iconv-lite.js && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.cf:build: npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker
